title: Savannah Cabana Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Savannah Cabana is a prime location one bedroom home located just 5 houses to the beach in Seaside and only 2 blocks to the Seaside Amphitheater and Central Square with over 35 shops and restaurants steps from your door!
description_expanded: Description49 SAVANNAH STREET1 KING BED, 1 QUEEN BED, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA (sleeps 6)Prime Location Near Beach & Town CenterLocated just five homes from the beach and only two blocks from Seaside Town Center, Savannah Cabana offers an unbeatable location in the heart of Seaside, Florida. This charming cottage is ideal for young families and couples looking to experience the best of 30A without needing a car. Beach access is just 266 feet away—a one-minute walk, while the Seaside Amphitheater and pedestrian-friendly town center are only a four-minute stroll from your front door. From here, you can easily walk to 35+ shops, restaurants, and local attractions.Inviting Outdoor LivingSavannah Cabana welcomes you with a private screened-in front porch, thoughtfully furnished with a bistro table for two—perfect for morning coffee—and classic Seaside rocking chairs that invite relaxed family moments and coastal breezes.Open-Concept Living & KitchenInside, the first floor features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen layout designed for comfort and connection. The living room includes a queen sleeper sofa to accommodate additional guests and a flat-screen TV for evenings in. The dining area comfortably seats four to six, making it easy to enjoy meals together after a day at the beach.The fully equipped kitchen includes granite countertops, a full-size refrigerator, electric stove, and dishwasher—everything you need for home-cooked meals or beach-day snacks.Comfortable Bedrooms & BathsAlso on the main level is the King primary bedroom, complete with a flat-screen TV and double-door access to the screened-in porch. A full bathroom with a walk-in shower and single vanity is conveniently located on the first floor. A newly added laundry area with a full-size washer and dryer adds extra convenience, along with an outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach.Upstairs, the open sleeping loft features a queen bed that sleeps two additional guests and overlooks the living space below. Across the home, a second loft—accessed by a ship’s ladder—serves as a kids’ lounge and hangout area, making Savannah Cabana especially appealing for families.A Cozy Seaside RetreatWith its unbeatable walkability, flexible sleeping spaces, and welcoming coastal charm, Savannah Cabana is a delightful Seaside vacation rental that puts you steps from the beach and moments from everything that makes Seaside, Florida so special.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES852 square feetSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on 30A1-minute walk, 266 feet to beach accessOutdoor grill and enclosed outdoor showerBonus sleeping loft with queen bedPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeWasher and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued per one-bedroom cottage (a golf cart is considered a car). Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002165
